title: plugin-security: the delegate business-unit read (#29029) is not reflected by canReadObject / security explain, and its aggregate arm has no pin
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Follow-up from the contract review of PR #30747 (card #29029, record 6673498665), should-fix items 1 and 2. Neither blocks that PR. ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #30747 adds `delegatedUnitReadScope` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`. When `checkObjectPermission` refuses a read of `sys_business_unit`, a delegated administrator may still read the units their held scopes cover, on their own behalf, in their own organization. This is per ruling 6663849489.

1. **`canReadObject` and `security/explain` do not reflect that read.** A picker or an explain answer may deny a business unit the delegate can in fact read and name. Expected: both answers say what the read door does.
2. **The `aggregate` arm has no pin.** `delegatedUnitReadScope` admits `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate`. The posture pins cover the first three only. Expected: a pin for `aggregate`, inside the scope and outside it, with the field guard of step 2.5b still applied.

Carried notes, no separate card asked:
- ADR-0090 D12 carries no note of the ruled read. Add it on the next ADR-0090 touch.
- The comment on `reference_not_found` in `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts` still says "does not exist". Fix it on the next spec touch.

Suggested grade: p3, `domain:server`. Serial: after PR #30747 lands.
